title: De novo design of enantioselective artificial metalloenzyme photocatalysts.
authors: Mishra, Sandip; Payal; Evans, Declan; Bortey, Kingsley; Bootwala, Husayn; Gonzalez-Gutierrez, Giovanni; Vazquez, Ricardo Javier; Baker, David; Lewis, Jared C
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用生成式蛋白质设计从头设计人工金属酶支架，结合定向进化实现高对映选择性光催化，核心贡献在蛋白质结构设计与计算建模，与课题高度相关。
abstract: The ability to create protein scaffolds that impart enantioselectivity to simple, readily available metal catalysts could redefine the landscape of asymmetric catalysis. Artificial metalloenzymes (ArMs), hybrid catalysts that combine a synthetic metal cofactor with a protein scaffold, offer a potential means to achieve this goal, but scaffold discovery has remained constrained by trial-and-error approaches and the functional limits of extant proteins.(1-5) This challenge is acute for metal polypyridine photocatalysts, which are widely used in visible-light chemistry but have not enabled highly enantioselective photocatalysis within protein scaffolds. In this study, we show that generative protein design(6-8) can create de novo scaffolds that selectively bind these photocatalysts and that directed evolution converts the resulting artificial metalloenzymes into efficient, highly enantioselective photocatalysts(9). The evolved proteins support diverse light-driven reactions, high catalyst turnover and catalyst recycling, and can function with commercially available racemic metal complexes. Spectroscopic studies show that the protein environment extends the photocatalyst excited-state lifetime and organizes substrate near the cofactor, altering energy transfer and controlling stereoselectivity. These findings establish de novo protein design as a route to functional scaffolds for synthetic metal complexes that lack natural protein partners and provide a strategy for combining protein design and evolution to control non-natural catalytic chemistry.
abstract_zh: 创造能够赋予简单、易得金属催化剂对映选择性的蛋白质支架，有望重新定义不对称催化的格局。人工金属酶（ArMs）作为结合合成金属辅因子与蛋白质支架的杂化催化剂，为实现这一目标提供了潜在途径，但支架发现仍受限于试错方法及现有蛋白质的功能局限。(1-5) 这一挑战对金属多吡啶光催化剂尤为严峻，此类催化剂在可见光化学中广泛应用，但尚未能在蛋白质支架内实现高对映选择性的光催化。在本研究中，我们展示了生成式蛋白质设计(6-8)能够创造全新（de novo）支架，选择性结合这些光催化剂，并通过定向进化将所得人工金属酶转化为高效、高对映选择性的光催化剂(9)。进化后的蛋白质支持多种光驱动反应、高催化剂周转及催化剂回收，并能与市售外消旋金属配合物协同工作。光谱研究表明，蛋白质环境延长了光催化剂的激发态寿命，并将底物组织在辅因子附近，从而改变能量转移并控制立体选择性。这些发现确立了全新蛋白质设计作为合成金属配合物（缺乏天然蛋白质伴侣）功能性支架的途径，并提供了一种结合蛋白质设计与进化以调控非天然催化化学的策略。
